I.value_zh: 已列出的文档、README、快照和发布记录；但“所有文档、GitHub、PyPI”的总体审查范围与列举文件是否穷尽未明确。
I.value_en: The listed documents, READMEs, snapshots, and release records; whether the phrase ‘all documents, GitHub, and PyPI’ is exhaustive of the enumerated files is not specified.
I.notes_zh: 不把未列举的仓库表面或 PyPI 状态补入确定范围。
I.notes_en: No unlisted repository surface or PyPI state is added to a determined scope.

O.value_zh: 文档级 patch、更新后的指定文档与发行记录，以及满足所列验收检查的结果。
O.value_en: A documentation-only patch, updated named documents and release records, and results satisfying the listed acceptance checks.
O.notes_zh: 不把 PyPI 发布、包版本或 tag 作为交付物。
O.notes_en: A PyPI release, package version change, or tag is not an output.

A.value_zh: 修订指定文档和发行记录、运行列明检查，并在后续同一 session 中记录、报告和归档任务。
A.value_en: Revise the named documents and release records, run the listed checks, and record, report, and archive the task in the stated follow-up session.
A.notes_zh: 动作语义来自原文；没有可核验的 L2 ontology，因此不绑定 action ID。
A.notes_en: Action semantics come from the source; no verifiable L2 ontology is available, so no action ID is bound.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 为发起与反馈主体；ME 为应交付、记录、报告和归档主体。
P.value_en: ADMIN is the initiating and feedback participant; ME is the participant assigned to deliver, record, report, and archive.
P.notes_zh: ME 和 ADMIN 保持原文符号，不推导身份、岗位或权限。
P.notes_en: ME and ADMIN remain source symbols; no identity, job title, or authority is inferred.

R.value_zh: 原文没有给出时间、预算、容量或数量配额；P1 优先级与测试断言不属于资源约束。
R.value_en: The source gives no time, budget, capacity, or quota constraint; priority P1 and test assertions are not resource constraints.
R.notes_zh: 不将优先级或 587/587 测试基线误归为 R。
R.notes_en: Priority and the 587/587 test baseline are not misclassified as R.

V.value_zh: FCoP protocol v1、0.6.6 文档级 patch、列出的 commits 与 docs/releases/0.6.6.md，以及 0.6.5 测试基线。
V.value_en: FCoP protocol v1, the 0.6.6 documentation patch, the listed commits and docs/releases/0.6.6.md, and the 0.6.5 test baseline.
V.notes_zh: 只记录原文引用，不验证或补造外部仓库内容。
V.notes_en: Only source-stated references are recorded; no external repository content is verified or invented.

C.value_zh: 列出的 lint、测试、快照、字符串、搜索和两版 README 结构对齐检查全部满足。
C.value_en: All listed lint, test, snapshot, string, search, and paired-README structure checks are satisfied.
C.notes_zh: 完成条件保留为显式检查的合取，不添加发布或审批条件。
C.notes_en: Completion remains the conjunction of explicit checks; no release or approval condition is added.

B.value_zh: 不得修改 _version.py、不得重发 PyPI、不得打 tag；快照不得变化；不得破坏指定标题；旧 highlights 搜索必须无匹配。
B.value_en: Do not modify _version.py, republish PyPI, or create a tag; snapshots must not change; the named title must remain; the old highlights search must have no matches.
B.notes_zh: 这些是 Task Boundary，不混入任何 Host policy。
B.notes_en: These are Task Boundary constraints; no Host policy is mixed in.
